title: Mitigating heavy metals leachability from CO2 carbonated coal-based solid waste backfill in high-salinity environments via biochar-clay-nanomaterial synergistic modification
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,21201-21219
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09892K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zhishang Zhang, Liqiang Ma, Ichhuy Ngo, Kunpeng Yu, Jiangtao Zhai, Zezhou Guo, Zhiyang Zhao, Chengkun Peng, Ruizhi Yang
Synergistic modifiers enhance CO2-carbonated backfill to suppress heavy metal leaching under high-salinity conditions. The immobilization is driven by physical encapsulation, electrostatic attraction, ion exchange, precipitation, and complexation.
